description: This file defines external function prototypes related to the System Repository Driver Object in a C/C++ project. It includes create, remove, enroll, and initialize functions for the Sys Repository Driver, indicating it serves as an API header for external modules to interact with this component.

methods.name: SysCreateRepositoryDriver
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Repository Driver instance with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SysRdoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the System Repository Driver object.

methods.name: SysRdoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified Repository Driver object.

methods.name: SysRdoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects or components within the Repository Driver object.

methods.name: SysRdoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Repository Driver object to a valid functional state.
